# Suites listed here are excluded from CI testing.
# One entry per line, format: examples/<name> or templates/<name>
# Lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# examples/web-webshop
# examples/cryptolibrary-simple
# examples/web-cryptolibrary

# web-roboland drives a real browser against demo.robotmk.org and needs a
# personal workspace key (ROBOLAND_KEY). Neither belongs in CI: the key would
# have to be a secret, and every run would place real orders in somebody's
# workspace. It is exercised where it matters instead — in the lab it ships
# with, and by TestKurssuite in the academy repository, which checks every
# selector it uses against the rendered application.
examples/web-roboland
